    Davante Adams, WR (LAR)

    Placed on injured reserve by Rams

    Home  >  News
    Oct 20 9:36pm
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:07
    Instaread

    Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

    As a result, Adams is slated to miss at least four games, although Ian Rapoport of NFL Network previously suggested that the wideout was hoping to return not too long after the Rams' Week 11 bye. In his absence, Jordan Whittington, Konata Mumpfield and Tutu Atwellare candidates to see added looks behind top WR Puka Nacua.

    Terrance Ferguson

    TE LAR
    7 hours ago

    Not expected back next week

    Ferguson (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, isn't expected to be ready at that time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

    Tyler Higbee

    TE LAR
    1 day ago

    Muted performance vs. Arizona

    Higbee caught all four of his targets for 22 yards during the Rams' 18-16 loss to the Cardinals on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

    Blake Grupe

    K LAR
    1 day ago

    Tears ACL, out for season

    Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

    Kobie Turner

    DL LAR
    1 day ago

    Bound for IR with groin injury

    Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Turner is expected to go on injured reserve after sustaining a groin strain in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

    Myles Garrett

    LB LAR
    1 day ago

    Not ready to return in Week 7

    Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Garrett (knee) won't have his 21-day practice window opened this week, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

    Davante Adams

    WR LAR
    1 day ago

    Needs surgery, eyeing post-bye return

    Adams sustained a ruptured left hamstring in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals and is slated to undergo a procedure that he hopes will allow him to return a little after the Rams' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

    Blake Grupe

    K LAR
    1 day ago

    Heads to IR after Week 6 exit

    The Rams placed Grupe (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

    Davante Adams

    WR LAR
    2 days ago

    Modest outing in Week 6

    Adams caught three of four targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 18-16 defeat against the Cardinals.

    Matthew Stafford

    QB LAR
    2 days ago

    Two more TD passes in Week 6

    Stafford was 25-for-33 passing for 222 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions during Sunday's 18-16 defeat against the Cardinals.

    Colby Parkinson

    TE LAR
    2 days ago

    Catches late TD in surprising loss

    Parkinson caught five of six targets for 31 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals.
